quiz_title: Class 45 Quiz: Qualities of a Devotee and Avoiding Harm

questions.question_text: Jene _______ grahaṇ karyāno swabhāv hoy teno ja satsangmā dṛuḍh pāyo thāy chhe.
questions.explanation: Vach.Lo.5 states: 'Jene guṇ grahaṇ karyāno swabhāv hoy teno ja satsangmā dṛuḍh pāyo thāy chhe.'

questions.question_text: Kevo swabhāv hoy teno satsangmā dṛuḍh pāyo thāy chhe?
questions.explanation: Vach.Lo.5 states: 'Jene guṇ grahaṇ karyāno swabhāv hoy teno ja satsangmā dṛuḍh pāyo thāy chhe.'

questions.question_text: Bhagwānnā bhaktnā guṇ kahevā, temānthī jīv _______ thaī jāy.
questions.explanation: Swa. Vato: 4/136 states: 'Bhagwānnā bhaktnā guṇ kahevā, temānthī jīv brahmarūp thaī jāy.'

questions.question_text: Bhagwānnā bhaktnā guṇ kahevāthī jīv kevo thaī jāy?
questions.explanation: Swa. Vato: 4/136 states: 'Bhagwānnā bhaktnā guṇ kahevā, temānthī jīv brahmarūp thaī jāy.'

questions.question_text: Avaguṇ koīno jevāno - _______ rasto na levo.
questions.explanation: Yogigita states: 'Avaguṇ koīno jevāno - jher pīvāno rasto na levo.'

questions.question_text: Yogigītā pramāṇe, kevo rasto na levo?
questions.explanation: Yogigita states: 'Avaguṇ koīno jevāno - jher pīvāno rasto na levo.'

questions.question_text: A sansārmā panch mahāpāpnā karanārāno koī divas chhūṭako thāy paṇ Bhagwānnā bhaktanā _______ karanārāno koī divas chhūṭako thato nathī.
questions.explanation: Vach.Ga.Ma.63 states: 'A sansārmā panch mahāpāpnā karanārāno koī divas chhūṭako thāy paṇ Bhagwānnā bhaktanā drohnā karanārāno koī divas chhūṭako thato nathī.'

questions.question_text: Kono koī divas chhūṭako thato nathī?
questions.explanation: Vach.Ga.Ma.63 states: 'A sansārmā panch mahāpāpnā karanārāno koī divas chhūṭako thāy paṇ Bhagwānnā bhaktanā drohnā karanārāno koī divas chhūṭako thato nathī.'

questions.question_text: Māṭe Bhagwānnā bhaktanī je sevā karavī te barobar koī _______ nathī ne Bhagwānnā bhaktano droh karavo te barobar koī pāp paṇ nathī.
questions.explanation: Vach.Ga.Ma.63 states: 'Māṭe Bhagwānnā bhaktanī je sevā karavī te barobar koī puṇya nathī ne Bhagwānnā bhaktano droh karavo te barobar koī pāp paṇ nathī.'

questions.question_text: Māṭe Bhagwānnā bhaktanī je sevā karavī te barobar koī _______ nathī ne Bhagwānnā bhaktano droh karavo te barobar koī _______ paṇ nathī.
questions.explanation: Vach.Ga.Ma.63 states: 'Māṭe Bhagwānnā bhaktanī je sevā karavī te barobar koī puṇya nathī ne Bhagwānnā bhaktano droh karavo te barobar koī pāp paṇ nathī.'
